svg.title: Fuse compared with dotnet build and dotnet test (fuse.codes)
svg.desc: Fuse, a faster .NET build and test loop for AI coding agents (fuse.codes, github.com/Litenova-Solutions/Fuse). Check an edit, fuse check against dotnet build. FluentValidation (4 projects): 0.25 seconds with Fuse, 2.28 seconds with dotnet, 9.0x faster at the median; Fuse 0.10 to 12.9 s, mean 0.75 s, P95 1.10 s; dotnet 1.56 to 9.16 s, mean 2.99 s, P95 8.16 s; NodaTime (15 projects): 1.15 seconds with Fuse, 3.95 seconds with dotnet, 3.4x faster at the median; Fuse 0.33 to 21.9 s, mean 2.59 s, P95 11.3 s; dotnet 2.20 to 12.5 s, mean 5.21 s, P95 10.7 s; Jellyfin (40 projects): 0.98 seconds with Fuse, 16.6 seconds with dotnet, 16.9x faster at the median; Fuse 0.16 to 84.8 s, mean 8.60 s, P95 55.4 s; dotnet 1.96 to 96.8 s, mean 21.8 s, P95 58.5 s; Polly (15 projects): 5.32 seconds with Fuse, 37.4 seconds with dotnet, 7.0x faster at the median; Fuse 1.74 to 52.8 s, mean 8.59 s, P95 26.4 s; dotnet 4.87 to 217.7 s, mean 54.7 s, P95 144.5 s. Run the affected tests, fuse test against dotnet test. FluentValidation (2,664 tests): 10.6 seconds with Fuse, 12.4 seconds with dotnet, 1.2x faster at the median; Fuse 8.57 to 45.7 s, mean 15.4 s, P95 45.7 s; dotnet 11.1 to 16.1 s, mean 12.9 s, P95 16.1 s; NodaTime (42,736 tests): 59.9 seconds with Fuse, 61.5 seconds with dotnet, 1.0x faster at the median; Fuse 0.14 to 105.5 s, mean 57.2 s, P95 105.5 s; dotnet 55.0 to 67.4 s, mean 61.2 s, P95 67.4 s; Jellyfin (2,535 tests): 106.1 seconds with Fuse, 166.6 seconds with dotnet, 1.6x faster at the median; Fuse 7.04 to 187.8 s, mean 111.8 s, P95 187.8 s; dotnet 144.3 to 195.0 s, mean 165.0 s, P95 195.0 s; Polly (12,329 tests): 48.3 seconds with Fuse, 115.7 seconds with dotnet, 2.4x faster at the median; Fuse 0.16 to 137.3 s, mean 45.8 s, P95 137.3 s; dotnet 91.9 to 132.5 s, mean 114.1 s, P95 132.5 s. Check on a warm engine, fuse check, P50 / P95 over the edits of each kind. FluentValidation: Body edit 296 / 482 ms, Signature edit 3,143 / 11,540 ms, Nothing changed, P50 30 ms; NodaTime: Body edit 808 / 1,263 ms, Signature edit 5,106 / 17,684 ms, Nothing changed, P50 37 ms; Jellyfin: Body edit 207 / 507 ms, Signature edit 133 / 150,496 ms, Nothing changed, P50 47 ms; Polly: Body edit 252 / 690 ms, Signature edit 616 / 48,572 ms, Nothing changed, P50 51 ms. Accuracy against the real build and test run, Counted against dotnet build and dotnet test on the same edits. FluentValidation: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 8 changes; NodaTime: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 7 changes; Jellyfin: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 2 changes; Polly: Build failed, Fuse passed 0 of 30 edits, Error the build contradicts 0 of 30 edits, Failing test not run 0 of 6 changes. Engine memory, Working set of the engine process. FluentValidation: After the checks 610 MB, Peak 616 MB, Idle 483 MB; NodaTime: After the checks 360 MB, Peak 629 MB, Idle 338 MB; Jellyfin: After the checks 536 MB, Peak 872 MB, Idle 519 MB; Polly: After the checks 700 MB, Peak 1,074 MB, Idle 698 MB. Swarm hypervisor and CLI, Zero-restore worktree check, brief check, and 20-request batch / 4-worktree RAM. FluentValidation: Zero-restore P50 2,222 ms, Brief check P50 698 ms, Batch / 4-wt RAM 67 ms / 340 MB; NodaTime: Zero-restore P50 2,597 ms, Brief check P50 930 ms, Batch / 4-wt RAM 108 ms / 516 MB; Jellyfin: Zero-restore P50 5,795 ms, Brief check P50 1,160 ms, Batch / 4-wt RAM 133 ms / 701 MB; Polly: Zero-restore P50 5,763 ms, Brief check P50 971 ms, Batch / 4-wt RAM 250 ms / 674 MB. Median times over the eval cases, each with the range from the fastest to the slowest case, the mean and P95, on GitHub Actions windows-latest runners.
